paper.title: Group-Evolving Agents: Open-Ended Self-Improvement via Experience Sharing
paper.central_claim: 把单亲隔离树进化改为父群共享经验，累积跨支系工具/工作流创新，改善编码任务、换模型迁移及框架bug恢复。

provenance.notes: 派发sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无可核验模型/会话收据，字段保留null，不探测。

materials.notes: manifest无page_images；图1–5仅使用正文与题注可读事实，不估图内数值。

evidence.quote: In fact, AI agents can directly share trajectories, tools, and learned artifacts, and they can aggregate complementary skills without the constraints of reproduction or lineage.
evidence.support_explanation: 被审核的单亲隔离假设及可行替代，不是生物隐喻本身。
二进制任务成功向量刻画行为；后接KNN余弦新颖性与性能乘积。

evidence.quote: The aggregated traces from all agents in the parent group are provided as shared input to every agent. Each agent evolves from this shared pool of group-level experience while diverging through complementary adaptations to its own codebase, enabling the group to explore diverse evolutionary directions while leveraging experiences from one another.
evidence.support_explanation: 共享失败轨迹/框架patch条件化反思和重写，每个父代码独立适应。

evidence.quote: These directives are then passed to the evolution module to generate framework-level patches. Finally, the updated agent is evaluated on downstream programming tasks via the action module. Agents that compile successfully and exhibit basic coding functionality are retained and added to the archive for future evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重框架patch的执行—保留—再进化闭环；不要求每孩子优于父亲。

evidence.quote: Finally, the top-2 performing agents from this stage are evaluated on the full SWE-bench Verified dataset.
evidence.support_explanation: 10任务sanity、50 Verified-Mini选优，再top2全量；Mini属全量子集，非完全密封留出。

evidence.quote: Agents achieving a success rate above 40% are subsequently evaluated on a separate, unseen 50-task medium set, ensuring that the larger set remains a strict out-of-distribution test for generalization.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确10任务进化/50任务分离作者声明；未说明多候选medium分数能否返用于选最终agent。

evidence.quote: To ensure fair comparison, we intentionally run the baseline for twice as many iterations as GEA so that the total number of evolved agents is comparable across methods, ensuring all comparisons are conducted under matched model schedules.
evidence.support_explanation: 匹配孩子数和Haiku/Sonnet切换日程，但非实测token/美元硬预算。

evidence.quote: On SWE-bench Verified, GEA improves performance from 20.0% to 71.0%, while under the same number of evolved agents, the DGM baseline achieves only 56.7%. On Polyglot, GEA boosts performance from 38.2% to 88.3%, significantly outperforming the DGM baseline (68.3%).
evidence.support_explanation: 主结果为作者报告，未复现；最终分母/跨run聚合不清，50例pass@1与88.3%等非整步数需说明。

evidence.quote: five of its integrated tools originated from different parent agents, confirming that explicit experience sharing prevents beneficial innovations from dying out.
evidence.support_explanation: 来源分析支持跨支系继承，不能单凭祖先数证明独立因果效应。

evidence.quote: Specifically, we replace the coding model used in the acting module with different GPT-series and Claude-series models during benchmark evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定最佳框架换执行模型比较初始框架，支持非权重改进；图内逐模型数字无页图不可编造。

evidence.quote: We report the number of evolution iterations required to repair injected bugs across five independent trials (E1–E5).
evidence.support_explanation: 五次局部扰动试验给出每次修复轮数，不是整个搜索的五个独立种子。

evidence.quote: We then form a group consisting of this faulty agent and another bug-free agent from its original parent group, and perform group evolution to assess whether GEA can leverage experience from the better-performing agent (i.e., the one without framework-level bugs) to repair the faulty one.
evidence.support_explanation: GEA额外有健康同伴；因果结论为共享健康经验的恢复，不是无此帮助等信息预算算法优越性。

evidence.quote: the estimated cost of completing a full run is approximately USD 13,000 per method on SWE-bench and USD 1,500 on Polyglot.
evidence.support_explanation: 有全run成本估计，明细主要benchmark calls，不是每臂实测token/美元分布或固定预算。
patch类型列出测试逻辑修改；缺具体diff，不能认定篡改评分器，也不能认为评测器不可改已审计。

evidence.quote: all experiments in this work are conducted in isolated sandbox environments, thereby limiting potential impacts on host systems.
evidence.support_explanation: 沙盒作者声明；编辑权限/评分器保护与回滚的细粒度边界未说明。
